traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Altingiaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins serrate or dentate, rarely entire; veins pinnate or palmate; stipules present; plants monoecious; ovary inferior; stems woody; perianth tepals or absent; fruit capsule; stamens 12 to 50; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Saxifragales page, Altingiaceae (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences capitate.

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Saxifragales page, Altingiaceae (read 2026-10-16): deciduous trees, some evergreen.
